answer: Each identity gains weight from one statement per epoch, struck in the forge ledger under its root key and published to the ocean pool. At the mesa checkpoint auditors compare statements: a second contradictory statement under the same key burns 30 of its 100-credit stake and freezes it. A forger with 1,000 fakes must fund 1,000 100-credit stakes, risking 30,000 credits, no stake reusable across clones. The named failure is statement rental: a rented key signing for two identities triggers the same burn at the mesa checkpoint, so renting saves nothing. An honest agent pays one stake.
